name: Punisher
identity: Olive-gray ogre wearing a full dark spotted helmet with a narrow gold eye slit, chain mail and spiked shoulder armor, holding a curved notched battle axe in RIGHT hand.
reference_review: Actually viewed atlas and complete battle/source reference: olive gray spotted helmet with narrow amber visor, exposed pale lower mouth, cream/ochre patched leather/ragged coat with visible stitching and laces (not metallic chainmail texture), one free-arm spiked shoulder plate and cuff, two short armored boots, one large curved crescent notched axe in anatomical RIGHT hand. No tail.
